{{Quote|Raystel, staying at his Delaya-based cottage, refused comment.|The HoloNet News report on the suspension of the Dean|<ref name="HNN" />}}
[[Halcor Raystel]], disgraced and former [[Dean/Legends|Dean]] for the [[University of Alderaan/Legends|University of Alderaan]], had a '''cottage''' on [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]],<ref name="HNN" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> He withdrew to the cottage following a suspension from his position after it came to light he had been abusing the [[Spice/Legends|substance]] [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] and coerced two [[Gender/Legends|female]] students. While at the cottage, he was approached by the [[HoloNet News/Legends|Holonet News]]' [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] for a news story on his suspension. He refused to comment and the story was published without his perspective on [[22 BBY/Legends|13:3:14]].<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The cottage was mentioned in<ref name="HNN" /> the [[March 14]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN47 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archivedate=20200305125429}}</ref> online article "Dean of Aldera Suspended" in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #47'']], an installment of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]].<ref name="HNN" /> The article was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
